public_rationale: The 2025-03-25 editorial reports extensive existing data alongside gaps for proposed virtual-cell models, particularly dynamic-state and perturbation proteomics data [e1]. It does not establish whether biological data available on 2026-11-12, together with feasible new data generation, were sufficient or insufficient to support the full four-disease cure goal within a decade [e1].
limitations: The editorial predates the publication-date snapshot and does not provide a field-wide inventory covering public and private datasets [e1].
It does not connect the identified gaps to validated data requirements and development timelines for the full cure goal [e1].

statement.excerpt: On the one hand, we don’t have the data:
statement.document_title: Breaking: Eli Lilly CEO becomes latest to push back on Dario Amodei’s ludicrous, Elizabeth Holmes-like medical claims

from_speaker: Context ties the data claim to doing what Dario says on his timeline.
our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that available biological data are inadequate to put the field in a position to deliver broad cures across the four named disease categories within a decade.
This is a claim about sufficiency for a particular goal, not a claim that biological datasets do not exist.
Use a snapshot at publication, 2026-11-12. There is no regular reporting quarter or other reporting cycle for field-wide biological data adequacy.
Do not adopt the quoted '<1% of biology' as a defined metric: the denominator and measurement method are unspecified.
Existing data gaps must be linked to the asserted cure timeline; their existence alone does not establish the full claim.
criteria.support_condition: A contemporaneous assessment identifies indispensable missing biological data and establishes why those deficits leave the field unable to deliver the stated breadth of cures within the decade, accounting for feasible new data generation.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A contemporaneous validated assessment establishes that available biological data are sufficient to support a credible route to the full stated cure goal within the decade.
